title: Tinh gọn modal xem bàn 3D và ổn định AR mặt sàn
rootCause: The parent AR launcher still writes ar-scale=auto immediately before activateAR. On Android native Scene Viewer that permits resizing, while native instant/depth tracking transitions can look like the object grows, shrinks or drifts as device distance changes. The shared action boundary now selects WebXR when available and normalizes the launch to fixed scale, while retaining Scene Viewer and Quick Look as device fallbacks.
